sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Packet creation and language checks
sections.what: Checks that area and family review packets can be created and reference their supporting documents. Also checks that a Hindi note added to a family packet leaves its identifier, status and evidence unchanged.
sections.why: Likely reason: packets must be reliable drafts that look the same regardless of the language shown.
sections.watch_out: The test writes packets to storage and does not show any cleanup.

summary: Tests that draft review packets can be created for potential issues and keep their references and identifiers unchanged across languages.
purpose: Checks that packets link to the right source documents and that switching language does not change identifiers, status or citizen notes.
why: Likely reason: the packet is a draft the citizen reviews, so its data must not depend on the language shown.
how: The single test in the first section creates an area packet and a family packet and checks they reference the supporting documents. A second test creates a family packet, updates its citizen notes in Hindi, and checks the identifier, status, evidence and notes stay as expected.
inputs: Demo case identifiers and verification result identifiers.
outputs: A pass or fail result for each test.
risks: These tests write packets to storage, and the file shows no cleanup step.
debug: If creation fails, check the verification result is a potential issue, since the service refuses other outcomes.
